agent_summary:
Lane 61 (Information gathering) against juice.lab.test — an OWASP Juice Shop v20.2.0 instance served over HTTP only (https/443 refused). 60 read-only requests performed; all 10 WSTG-INFO items done with evidence.

Server & app fingerprint (INFO-02/08/09): nginx/1.30.5 reverse proxy fronting an Express ^4.22.1 / Node backend (confirmed via verbose stack traces naming /juice-shop/build/routes/*.js and node_modules/express), Angular + Angular-Material SPA frontend; app = OWASP Juice Shop v20.2.0 (X-Recruiting header, /rest/admin/application-version).

Metafiles (INFO-03): robots.txt (Disallow /ftp), security.txt (contact, PGP, csaf→http://localhost:3000), CSAF provider-metadata; sitemap.xml returns the SPA index (no real sitemap).

Architecture (INFO-10): nginx→Express on localhost:3000, Angular SPA, socket.io/engine.io, chatbot LLM (gemma4), web3/wallet features, SQLite local backup; Google OAuth config + authorizedRedirects exposed via unauthenticated /rest/admin/application-configuration.

Entry points / execution paths (INFO-06/07): enumerated SPA client routes and server /api/* and /rest/* from main.js; mapped reachability/auth by status — public (200): /api/Products, /api/Quantitys, /api/Recycles, /api/Deliverys, /api/Feedbacks, /api/SecurityQuestions, /rest/products/search?q=, /rest/products/:id/reviews, /rest/track-order/:id, /rest/captcha, /rest/memories, /rest/web3/nftUnlocked, /rest/languages, /rest/user/whoami, /rest/user/security-question?email=; auth-protected (401): /api/Users, /api/Cards, /api/Complaints, /api/Addresss, /api/SecurityAnswers, /api/BasketItems, /rest/wallet/balance, /rest/order-history*, /rest/image-captcha, /rest/user/authentication-details, /b2b/v2/orders; nginx 404 (not proxied): /api/Challenges, /api/Hints, /rest/continue-code, /rest/repeat-notification. Unknown paths otherwise fall through to the SPA index (catch-all). Parameterized inputs: search q, security-question email, /redirect?to= (allowlist → 406).

Content leakage (INFO-01/05): browsable /ftp directory (incl. nested /ftp/quarantine) exposing backups and a confidential acquisitions.md; /rest/memories leaks full user records (password hashes, deluxeToken, totpSecret, admin bkimminich); /api/Feedbacks leaks a 12-word wallet seed phrase and partial emails; application-configuration leaks OAuth clientId; /metrics exposes unauthenticated Prometheus data; verbose stack traces; wildcard CORS (ACAO:* even with a foreign Origin); no source maps found (main.js.map → SPA index).

Leads recorded: high — /rest/memories credential-hash/token disclosure; medium — browsable /ftp with confidential/backup files; low — unauth /metrics, verbose stack traces, unauth application-configuration; info — wildcard CORS.

Nothing left open. Writes were not needed (read-only engagement, no test accounts). Note: active external search-engine queries (INFO-01) are off-host and out of scope for the request tool; documented via the host's own indexable signals instead.

leads.title: [agent] Browsable /ftp directory exposes confidential and backup files

detail.text: GET /ftp returns a full directory listing (serve-index) of 11 entries including package.json.bak, package-lock.json.bak, coupons_2013.md.bak, incident-support.kdbx, suspicious_errors.yml, and acquisitions.md. /ftp/acquisitions.md (served, 200) is explicitly labelled "This document is confidential! Do not distribute!". Non-.md/.pdf downloads are blocked with a verbose Express stack trace.

leads.title: [agent] Unauthenticated /rest/memories exposes user password hashes and tokens

detail.text: GET /rest/memories (no auth) returns photo-wall entries that embed the full associated User object, including email, password hash, role, deluxeToken and totpSecret fields for users such as an admin (username bkimminich, role admin) and a deluxe user. Sensitive account data and credential hashes are disclosed to anonymous callers.

GET /metrics returns full Prometheus metrics without authentication, disclosing process memory/CPU, open file descriptors, Node event-loop lag, startup task timings and HTTP status-code counters for the juiceshop app.

leads.title: [agent] Unauthenticated application-configuration discloses OAuth client id and internal config

detail.text: GET /rest/admin/application-configuration returns the full runtime config without auth, including googleOauth.clientId, authorizedRedirects list, privacy contact email, chatbot LLM model, and server baseUrl http://localhost:3000.

leads.title: [agent] Verbose server error stack traces leak internal paths and framework versions

detail.text: Error responses (e.g. blocked /ftp/*.bak download, 401 /api/Users) return full Express stack traces including absolute server paths (/juice-shop/build/routes/fileServer.js, /juice-shop/node_modules/express/...) and the framework banner "OWASP Juice Shop (Express ^4.22.1)".

All observed responses (root, /api/*, /rest/*) return Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and OPTIONS /api/Products advertises Access-Control-Allow-Methods GET,HEAD,PUT,PATCH,POST,DELETE, allowing any origin to read API responses.
